changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.comment: Un-escape title in topics (store raw, escape at render)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE topics SET title = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(title, '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&') WHERE title IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.comment: Un-escape legacy title in comments (store raw, escape at render)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE comments SET title = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(title, '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&') WHERE title IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.comment: Un-escape oldtitle in edit_info history (topics and comments)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE edit_info SET oldtitle = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(oldtitle, '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', ''''), '&', '&') WHERE oldtitle IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.comment: Decode legacy makeTitle entities in oldtitle; un-escape zero-padded ' in titles

changeSet.author: maxcom
changeSet.sql: UPDATE edit_info SET oldtitle = replace(oldtitle, ''', '''') WHERE oldtitle LIKE '%'%'
